nodes.label: Capacitor WebView Shell (Android)
nodes.rationale: Replaced the Trusted Web Activity build: a TWA renders through Chrome, so on a phone whose browser does not support it Android asks the user to pick a browser, which is not an app experience. A WebView never does that, and site updates still reach users instantly because the shell only loads the URL.

nodes.label: Firebase Config Restore Step
nodes.rationale: google-services.json is kept out of the public repo, so it is base64-restored from a secret before the Gradle plugin looks for it; without it the app builds fine but never receives a device token.

nodes.label: APK Signature Verification
nodes.rationale: Android refuses to install an unsigned package, so apksigner proves the artifact is signed inside CI rather than the failure being discovered on a user's phone.

nodes.label: AAB Bundle Artifact
nodes.rationale: Google Play accepts only the bundle format for new apps, so the build produces muhta.aab alongside the sideloadable muhta.apk.
